findings.message: area.decor.area.2.0 (listStack) sets props.divider=true, which inserts a 1px contents divider between every adjacent child including TitleSectionComboResult → ListTextDuplicateCheck. Per LAYOUT_SPACING_CONTRACT, divider should ride between repeating list rows, not between the section title and its first row.
findings.suggestion: Either (a) move TitleSectionComboResult outside the listStack so the divider applies only to ListText/ListSelected row pair, or (b) keep TitleSection in stack but ensure renderer suppresses the divider on the title boundary; minimally narrow divider scope to the rows.

findings.message: ListSelectedGroupProduct.props.checked=true was set, but SourceSpec only provides `RadioText: {그룹상품명}` and binds to selectedGroupProduct state without specifying a default selected. Hard-coding checked=true invents a state not present in source evidence and may misrepresent the actual selection.
findings.suggestion: Remove checked (let it default to false/unbound) or bind it to selectedGroupProduct state via {bind: 'selectedGroupProduct'} so the radio reflects real state.

findings.message: TextButton underline=true was introduced without source evidence; SourceSpec only carries label '나중에 다시 보기'. Per visual-foundation rules, emphasis should come from component contract defaults, not invented style props.
findings.suggestion: Drop the underline prop unless component contract documents underline as the default visual treatment for secondary TextButton.

findings.message: TextButtonViewLater sits directly below Callout inside the feedback stack. The plan correctly lowers its weight, but visually it still competes with the section's primary message. Consider an additional spacing cue or right-aligning to ensure it reads as a tertiary action below the recovery CTA in hierarchy.
findings.suggestion: Verify rendered TextButton uses small/secondary visual weight (no underline + smaller size) so Callout remains the 1순위 anchor.

findings.message: Source area 1 declares errorPolicy '영역 전체 숨김' and stateCoverageHints include async/error, but the area only carries display.stateRole='base' with no display.when binding for the hide-on-error policy. The visible composition is fine for populated state, but error coverage is not expressed.
findings.suggestion: Add display.when bound to a feedback availability flag (e.g. {bind:'failReasonAvailable'}) so the area can be fully hidden per the source errorPolicy.
